svg.aria-label: Byte-pair encoding on the text: the cat sat on the mat. It starts as 22 pieces, one per letter or space. Glue 1 joins a and t, which appear together 3 times, giving 19 pieces. Glue 2 joins t and h, giving 17. Glue 3 joins th and e, giving 15 pieces: the, space, c, at, space, s, at, space, o, n, space, the, space, m, at.
svg.text: Byte-pair encoding, one glue at a time
Find the most common neighbouring pair, glue it into one piece, and repeat

g.text: start: every letter and space is a piece
glue 2: t + h appears twice, and comes first
